Container.Name: kw-ops
Container.Overview:
The Docker collector for one host. kw-core calls it on kw-internal and shows every container on the host in the admin console, plus each Healthchecks check and each database backup folder. Read-only and stateless; it returns fixed whitelists only.
NETWORKS: two, set by System Admin after the container is created (the template carries one network only, so leave Network as shipped). (1) kw-internal, at the fixed address System Admin records, which kw-core calls. (2) The private socket-proxy network, which holds this container and docker-proxy and nothing else. Neither network is reachable from the LAN and the container publishes no port.
HARDENING, for System Admin to set live in Extra Parameters (the repo template ships Extra Parameters empty, by rule): --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:size=16m --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --ulimit core=0 --pids-limit 128 --cpus 0.5 --cpu-shares 256 --memory 128m --memory-swap 128m --oom-score-adj 500. These ceilings are a proposal, not measured under Docker; confirm with docker stats on a dev host and report an excess rather than raising a limit.
HEALTH: the image HEALTHCHECK calls GET /v1/health and needs no bearer. The container runs as 99:100 and has no socket.
VARIABLES: KW_OPS_COLLECTOR_BEARER_SHA256 is required (the hex SHA-256 of the bearer kw-core presents; the bearer itself is never entered here). Blank optional Variables fall back to the defaults shown. Leave the Healthchecks and backup Variables blank until System Admin sets them; blank means that source reports not-configured.
Container.Description: Docker and Healthchecks collector for one host, read-only, for the admin console. No port; reached by kw-core on kw-internal. Needs the docker-proxy container up on its private network first.

Config.Name: Collector bearer digest
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The hex SHA-256 of the bearer kw-core presents: 64 lowercase hex characters, format <sha256-hex>. The service does not start without it. The bearer itself is a vault item and is never entered here.

Config.Name: Collector bearer digest (next, rotation only)
Config.Description: Optional. Rotation only: the SHA-256 hex digest of the next bearer, format <sha256-hex>. Both are accepted until a restart with the next one alone. Leave blank otherwise.

Config.Name: Docker proxy URL
Config.Description: The socket proxy's address, format http://host[:port], nothing more. The default is the docker-proxy container's name on its private network. Blank means the default.

Config.Name: Minimum refresh seconds
Config.Description: Floor between reads of each source (Docker, Healthchecks, backup folders), 5 to 300 seconds. Blank means 20.

Config.Name: Healthchecks URL
Config.Description: Optional. The Healthchecks service, format https://<host>[:port] for the hosted service (reached through the egress proxy below) or http://<host>[:port] for a self-hosted one on kw-internal. Blank means checks are not-configured.

Config.Name: Healthchecks read-only key file
Config.Description: The path, inside the container, of the mounted file that holds a READ-ONLY Healthchecks API key. The default matches the Path below. Only the path is a setting; the key is never entered here.

Config.Name: Backup folders
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated database folder names under /backups, format <folder>,<folder>. Plain names only. Blank means backups are not-configured.

Config.Name: Egress proxy
Config.Description: Optional. The stack's egress proxy (kw-proxy), format http://<host>:<port>, nothing more. Used only to reach an https Healthchecks address. Blank means a direct connection, which kw-internal cannot make to the hosted service.

Config.Name: Database backups
Config.Description: Optional. The parent folder of the per-database backup folders, format /mnt/<pool>/<backup-path>. Mounted read-only; the folder names go in KW_OPS_BACKUP_FOLDERS. Leave blank until backups are wired.

Config.Name: Healthchecks key file
Config.Description: Optional. The host file holding the READ-ONLY Healthchecks API key, format /mnt/<pool>/<secrets-path>/<file>. Mounted read-only. The file must exist before the container starts, or Docker creates a folder in its place. Written by System Admin.
